title: Provider inventory metadata is compiler-owned
observed_need: Expose compiler-owned TestCase, declaration, callable, and signature identities to the native provider so it can validate identity-bound execution receipts.
current_language_behavior: The loaded compiler artifact exposes artifact-bound callable binding metadata across modules. The generic structured projection boundary materializes the bounded provider request, and native mncs-test validates the receipt identities against those bindings.
why_insufficient: Resolved. The former generated source table duplicated compiler-issued identity rows and is no longer needed; a newly added TestCase is visible through the artifact metadata path without provider source generation.
minimal_reproducer: Run tests/test_provider_projection.py: compiler-issued bindings cover TestCases from different modules, stale or foreign receipts fail, and a newly added declaration is visible without generating provider_inventory.mncs.
desired_direction: Keep TestCase, declaration, callable, signature, and artifact identity authority in compiler metadata and validate receipts through the single native provider path.
workaround: Removed: provider inventory source generation and the duplicate identity table.
